forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {夢見|ゆめみ}ていませんでした

definitions.explanation: To see a dream during sleep.

definitions.gloss: to dream of, to yearn for
definitions.explanation: To have hopes or aspirations for something in the future.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧、⟦{変|へん}→変：01124_hen⟧な⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{夢見|ゆめみ}た。
examples.english: I had a strange dream last night.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧、⟦{宇宙飛行士|うちゅうひこうし}→宇宙飛行士：28176_uchuuhikoushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{夢見|ゆめみ}て⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, I dreamed of becoming an astronaut.

examples.japanese: ⟦{平和|へいわ}→平和：01507_heiwa⟧な⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{夢見|ゆめみ}て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many people dream of a peaceful world.

notes:
{夢見|ゆめみ}る is a compound verb from ⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧ (dream) and ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to see). It conjugates as an ichidan verb.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)

ASPECT (ている):
- {夢見|ゆめみ}て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ means 'is dreaming of' (ongoing aspiration) or 'is having a dream' (during sleep)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to have a dream (more common for literal sleep dreams)
- {夢見|ゆめみ}る: literary/aspirational nuance, often used for hopes and ideals
